teaching.student_prompt: 看图读出 tights，再用它说一个短句。
teaching.note: 面向 KET 学生的原创短句；图片、释义与本课常用词义一致。

word_study.explanation_zh: 把 tights 作为完整单词记住，再用 a pair of tights 建立实用联系。

family.connection_zh: tights 用复数形式，计数时说 a pair of tights。

example.en: I need a pair of tights.

challenge.prompt_zh: 请说出一个和 tights 有联系的词或短语。
challenge.answer_zh: a pair of tights（一条连裤袜）

images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: reusable classroom vocabulary photograph for Chinese primary-school KET learners, displayed large on a projector; landscape 3:2, ideally 1536x1024.
Style: beautiful, playful, realistic editorial photography; bright natural light; vivid but plausible colours; real materials and textures; uncluttered composition with one unmistakable main idea.
Composition: fully visible main subject, generous margins, clear at classroom distance.
Constraints: no embedded text, letters, labels, numbers, logos, watermarks, decorative frames, cartoons or clipart; safe child-friendly scene; correct anatomy and plausible scale.
Primary request: One pair of colourful child-size tights laid fully visible beside a simple skirt, no person wearing them.
